sql.sql: SELECT * FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT ORDER BY BRAND_NM

SELECT r.*, t.TERR_NM, t.DISTRICT_ID AS T_DIST, g.BRAND_NM, g.FQTR, g.TRX_GOAL FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t ON r.TERR_ID=t.TERR_ID LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.IC_GOAL g ON g.REP_ID=r.REP_ID WHERE r.DISTRICT_ID ILIKE '%03%' OR t.DISTRICT_ID ILIKE '%03%' ORDER BY r.REP_ID
SELECT BRAND_NM, FQTR, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT REP_ID), SUM(TRX_GOAL) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.IC_GOAL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT), MAX(WK_END_DT), COUNT(DISTINCT WK_END_DT), DAYNAME(MAX(WK_END_DT)) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY
SELECT PROD_NDC11, LENGTH(PROD_NDC11) L, COUNT(*), SUM(TRX_QTY) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY WHERE WK_END_DT>='2026-06-26' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT WK_END_DT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT WK_END_DT||PRSCRBR_ME||PROD_NDC11||PLAN_ID||CHNL_CD) nd, SUM(TRX_QTY) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY WHERE WK_END_DT>='2026-06-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.REP_ID, r.TERR_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.PRSCRBR_ME) n_tgt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.TERR_ID=r.TERR_ID THEN cp.PRSCRBR_ME END) in_terr, LISTAGG(DISTINCT cp.TARGET_TYP, ',') typ
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_PLAN cp JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r ON r.REP_ID=cp.REP_ID LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME=cp.PRSCRBR_ME
WHERE r.DISTRICT_ID='D-03' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT p.TERR_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PRSCRBR_ME) n_hcp, COUNT(*) n_dup_rows FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p WHERE p.TERR_ID LIKE 'T03%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN p.PRSCRBR_ME IS NULL THEN 'UNMATCHED' ELSE 'MATCHED' END m, SUM(x.TRX_QTY) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY x LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME=x.PRSCRBR_ME WHERE x.WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-03' AND '2026-09-25' AND x.PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110') GROUP BY 1

WITH trx AS (
  SELECT p.TERR_ID, SUM(x.TRX_QTY) trx, SUM(x.NRX_QTY) nrx, COUNT(DISTINCT x.WK_END_DT) wks, MIN(x.WK_END_DT) mn, MAX(x.WK_END_DT) mx
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY x
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr ON pr.PROD_NDC11=x.PROD_NDC11 AND pr.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA'
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME=x.PRSCRBR_ME
  WHERE x.WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-03' AND '2026-09-25'
  GROUP BY 1),
tgt AS (
  SELECT cp.REP_ID, SUM(x.TRX_QTY) tgt_trx
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_PLAN cp
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY x ON x.PRSCRBR_ME=cp.PRSCRBR_ME
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr ON pr.PROD_NDC11=x.PROD_NDC11 AND pr.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA'
  WHERE cp.FQTR='2026Q3' AND x.WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-03' AND '2026-09-25'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.REP_ID, r.REP_NM, r.TEAM, r.TERR_ID, g.TRX_GOAL, t.trx, ROUND(100*t.trx/g.TRX_GOAL,1) att_pct, t.trx-g.TRX_GOAL gap, tg.tgt_trx, t.wks, t.mn, t.mx
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.IC_GOAL g ON g.REP_ID=r.REP_ID AND g.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND g.FQTR='2026Q3'
LEFT JOIN trx t ON t.TERR_ID=r.TERR_ID
LEFT JOIN tgt tg ON tg.REP_ID=r.REP_ID
WHERE r.DISTRICT_ID='D-03' ORDER BY r.TERR_ID, r.TEAM
